title: 1.5 Electromagnetic Radiation and Atomic Spectra
description: Electromagnetic spectrum, wave properties, photons and quantum theory, atomic spectra, the Bohr model, and wave-particle duality

questions.question: In 1873, which physicist proposed that light consists of electromagnetic waves?
An electromagnetic wave has two components that vibrate in mutually perpendicular planes. They are the:
The wavelength ($\lambda$) of an electromagnetic wave is:
options: the distance the wave travels during one cycle
the number of cycles the wave undergoes per second
the time for one cycle to pass a point
questions.correctAnswer: the distance the wave travels during one cycle

questions.question: The frequency ($\nu$) of an electromagnetic wave is the number of cycles the wave undergoes per second and is expressed in units of:
The speed ($c$) of a wave is related to its wavelength and frequency by:
In a vacuum, electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of light, which is:
Which of the following regions of the electromagnetic spectrum consists of radiation with the shortest wavelength?
In the visible spectrum, red light has a wavelength of about 750 nm and violet light a wavelength of about 380 nm. Which color has the longer wavelength?
The value of Planck's constant ($h$) used in the equation $E = h\nu$ is:
In 1900, Max Planck proposed the revolutionary idea that energy, like matter, is:
options: discontinuous and is emitted or absorbed only in discrete quantities called quanta
always in the form of mechanical work
questions.correctAnswer: discontinuous and is emitted or absorbed only in discrete quantities called quanta

questions.question: According to Planck, the energy of a single quantum is proportional to:

According to quantum theory, energy is always emitted or absorbed through a system in:
In 1905, which scientist used the quantum theory to explain the photoelectric effect?
The threshold frequency ($\nu_o$) in the photoelectric effect is the:
options: minimum frequency of light required to eject electrons from the metal surface
maximum frequency of light absorbed by a metal
questions.correctAnswer: minimum frequency of light required to eject electrons from the metal surface

questions.question: In the photoelectric effect, a photon with energy less than $E_o$ (so that $\nu < \nu_o$):
options: cannot remove an electron from the metal surface
removes an electron with low kinetic energy
questions.correctAnswer: cannot remove an electron from the metal surface

A photon is best described as:
options: a particle of light or an energy packet
a charged particle in the cathode ray
questions.correctAnswer: a particle of light or an energy packet

questions.question: Einstein's equation $E = mc^2$ implies which of the following?
options: mass has no relation to energy
energy and mass are always equal in value
energy moves at constant speed in all media

questions.question: When an electric discharge passes through hydrogen gas and the emitted light is passed through a prism, the pattern observed is:
options: a series of individual lines (an atomic or line spectrum)
a single broad band of white light
questions.correctAnswer: a series of individual lines (an atomic or line spectrum)

questions.question: The wavelengths of the lines in an element's emission spectrum are:
options: characteristic of the element producing them and used for its identification
the same as those of sunlight
questions.correctAnswer: characteristic of the element producing them and used for its identification

questions.question: According to Bohr's model, the electron in a hydrogen atom travels around the nucleus in a circular orbit, and the energy of the electron is proportional to:
options: its distance from the nucleus (the further, the more energy)
questions.correctAnswer: its distance from the nucleus (the further, the more energy)

questions.question: Bohr introduced the quantum condition that the angular momentum of the electron ($mvr$) can take only values that are:
According to Bohr, the radius of the first (lowest) orbit ($n = 1$) of the hydrogen atom is:
Bohr showed that the energy of the electron in the hydrogen atom is $E_n = -R_H/n^2$, where $R_H = 2.18 \times 10^{-18}$ J. The negative sign signifies that:
options: the energy of the electron in the atom is lower than that of a free electron
the energy of the electron is always negative in value
questions.correctAnswer: the energy of the electron in the atom is lower than that of a free electron
